append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1664). RE-TESTED on main at 7a051af6e: the title does not hold as written. On circle, event and Space pages the panel resolves no personal App at all (the personal set mounts only on global and profile scopes), and no catalog App declares both global and an entity scope. The consequence is real on the profile scope: /people/<handle> read only the profile rows and applied no override to the personal set, and the Profile, Spotlight, Layout and Spotlight appearance editors mount only there, so a global disable of any of them did nothing anywhere. A stored global disable of a circle, event or Space App was ignored on its own page too. FIX: one resolver, resolveScopeAppOverrides (lib/apps/overrides.ts), folds the Apps disabled at global into the page scope's own rows (disable only; a global position or role floor stays global; a global disable beats a scope enable). The shell's cached loadCachedAppOverrides and resolveAppsForScope both go through it, and the panel drops disabled personal Apps off the global scope. TESTS: components/layout/settings-panel.global-disable.test.tsx runs the real panel hook on a global, profile, circle, event and Space page (shows with no override, gone once disabled at global), lib/layout/chrome-sources.app-overrides.test.ts, lib/apps/overrides.test.ts. No migration.
